display.purpose: The stacked Baloch Digital identity in the first viewport.

headline.purpose: Large multi-line strategy names and no other body copy.

body.purpose: Compact supporting explanations held to a readable measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase strategy metadata, system readouts, and contact status.

shadows.name: signal-text-glow
shadows.purpose: The only explicit shadow; it marks an actively hovered strategy title.

motion.name: ease-expressive-out
motion.purpose: Shared deceleration for reveals, strategy reactions, and contact-rail docking.

motion.name: orbital-rotation
motion.purpose: Near-imperceptible continuous rotation of the hero orbital geometry.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-entry fade, blur release, lift, and scale settlement.

motion.name: strategy-response
motion.purpose: Title and description response on devices with hover.

motion.name: contact-dock
motion.purpose: Moves the contact rail from the viewport floor to its centered closing state.

components.name: Hero Wordmark
components.description: The monumental two-line identity and its signal-green protocol label.
components.css: .ds-hero-wordmark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; color: var(--foreground, #eaeaea); font-family: var(--font-space-mono, monospace); text-align: center; mix-blend-mode: difference; } .ds-hero-wordmark h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 11vw; font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-hero-wordmark h1 span { display: block; } .ds-hero-wordmark p { margin: 4vh 0 0; color: var(--signal, #01ff00); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 0.4em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (max-width: 768px) { .ds-hero-wordmark h1 { font-size: 15vw; line-height: 0.94; } .ds-hero-wordmark p { max-width: 28rem; font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.24em; } }

components.name: Orbital Geometry
components.description: The rotating vector instrument behind the hero identity.
components.html: <svg class="ds-orbital" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="48" class="ds-orbital-dashed" stroke-width="0.2" stroke-dasharray="1 2"/><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="35" class="ds-orbital-muted" stroke-width="0.5"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="49" ry="15" class="ds-orbital-bright" stroke-width="0.1" transform="rotate(30 50 50)"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="49" ry="15" class="ds-orbital-bright" stroke-width="0.1" transform="rotate(-60 50 50)"/><path d="M 50 0 L 50 100 M 0 50 L 100 50" class="ds-orbital-signal" stroke-width="0.5"/><path d="M 50 45 L 50 55 M 45 50 L 55 50 M 46.5 46.5 L 53.5 53.5 M 46.5 53.5 L 53.5 46.5" class="ds-orbital-core" stroke-width="0.5"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-orbital { display: block; width: min(80vw, 800px); height: auto; opacity: 0.66; animation: ds-slow-rotate 120s linear infinite; } .ds-orbital-dashed { stroke: rgba(154, 182, 217, 0.36); } .ds-orbital-muted { stroke: var(--line, rgba(234, 234, 234, 0.12)); } .ds-orbital-bright { stroke: var(--foreground, #eaeaea); } .ds-orbital-signal { stroke: var(--signal, #01ff00); opacity: 0.5; } .ds-orbital-core { stroke: var(--signal, #01ff00); } @keyframes ds-slow-rotate { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-orbital { animation: none; } }

components.name: Strategy Frame
components.description: An alternating strategy composition with telemetry, a monumental headline, and hover calibration.
components.html:
STRATEGY // 01GENESIS VECTORSTATUS: DEPLOYING

Venture
Activism

We identify promising early-stage ventures, invest across private and open markets, and actively support their growth, product, and distribution.
components.css: .ds-strategy { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; gap: 4vw; align-items: end; color: var(--foreground, #eaeaea); font-family: var(--font-space-mono, monospace); } .ds-strategy::before { position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: -2rem; background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(1, 255, 0, 0.055), transparent 60%); content: ''; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.8s ease; } .ds-strategy-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0 0 0.5vw 1vw; border-left: 1px solid var(--signal, #01ff00); color: var(--muted, #787883); font-size: 0.65rem; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-strategy-meta span:first-child { color: var(--signal, #01ff00); } .ds-strategy h2 { position: relative; margin: 0; font-size: 5vw; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.04em; transition: color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), text-shadow 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-strategy h2::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -8px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--signal, #01ff00); content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-strategy p { grid-column: 1 / -1; max-width: 52ch; margin: 2rem 0 0; color: var(--muted, #787883); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-strategy:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-strategy:hover h2 { color: var(--signal, #01ff00); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(1, 255, 0, 0.3); transform: translateX(12px); } .ds-strategy:hover h2::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-strategy:hover p { color: var(--foreground, #eaeaea); transform: translateY(-4px); } @media (max-width: 768px) { .ds-strategy { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; text-align: left; } .ds-strategy h2 { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 11vw, 4.5rem); } .ds-strategy p { max-width: 100%; font-size: 0.72rem; } } @media (hover: none) { .ds-strategy:hover h2, .ds-strategy:hover p { color: inherit; text-shadow: none; transform: none; } .ds-strategy:hover h2::after { transform: scaleX(0); } }

components.name: System Readout
components.description: A marginal two-line telemetry label for version, mode, and synchronized status.
components.css: .ds-system-readout { color: var(--muted, #787883); font-family: var(--font-space-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.65rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (max-width: 768px) { .ds-system-readout { display: none; } }

components.name: Social Link
components.description: A compact icon link with a dormant telemetry state and an explicit signal focus state.
components.css: .ds-social-link { display: inline-flex; min-width: 32px; min-height: 32px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--muted, #787883); outline: none; transition: color 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease; } .ds-social-link:hover { color: var(--signal, #01ff00); } .ds-social-link:focus-visible { color: var(--background, #030304); background: var(--signal, #01ff00); } .ds-social-link:active { color: var(--background, #030304); background: var(--foreground, #eaeaea); }

components.name: Docking Contact Rail
components.description: The fixed contact chrome that becomes the centered closing event at the document end.
components.css: .ds-contact-rail { display: flex; min-height: 58px; align-items: center; padding: 15px clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 3.75rem); border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(234, 234, 234, 0.12)); background: rgba(3, 3, 4, 0.97); color: var(--muted, #787883); font-family: var(--font-space-mono, monospace); transition: padding 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-contact-rail.is-closing { justify-content: center; padding: 24px clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 3.75rem); border-top-color: var(--signal, #01ff00); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--signal, #01ff00); background: rgba(3, 3, 4, 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-contact-rail div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-contact-rail span { margin-right: 0.5rem; color: var(--signal, #01ff00); } .ds-contact-rail a { display: inline-flex; min-width: 32px; min-height: 32px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--muted, #787883); text-decoration: none; outline: none; transition: color 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease; } .ds-contact-rail a:hover { color: var(--signal, #01ff00); } .ds-contact-rail a:focus-visible { color: var(--background, #030304); background: var(--signal, #01ff00); } .ds-contact-rail a:active { color: var(--background, #030304); background: var(--foreground, #eaeaea); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-contact-rail { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
Baloch Digital presents as a single technical instrument rather than a conventional fund website. A near-black field, monumental monospaced type, fine measurement lines, and orbital vector geometry make the interface feel precise, speculative, and controlled without borrowing credibility from generic portraits, cards, or decorative luxury cues.

The system is sparse but not quiet: scale creates authority, signal green marks live state, and slow choreography gives the page a sense of calibration in progress. Every layer stays legible as part of one instrument plane, from marginal system readouts to the strategy frames and the contact rail that docks at the close.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black full-bleed instrument field with no card chrome.
Monumental monospaced identity and strategy typography.
Signal green reserved for live state, guidance, and interaction.
Hairline measurement grids and orbital vector geometry supply structure.
Slow, deliberate reveal and docking motion; reduced motion stays complete.

rules.name: The One Instrument Rule
rules.body: Every visible element should feel calibrated to the same near-black field; avoid disconnected themed panels.

rules.name: The Signal Is State Rule
rules.body: Use signal green only for protocol labels, live status, geometry cores, focus, and intentional interaction; never as a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The Scale Carries Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Weight stays mostly regular; hierarchy comes from viewport-relative size, line height, spacing, and case.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Plane Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces flat at rest. Create depth with opacity, blend, hairlines, motion, and the single signal glow—not generic card shadows.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: Panels, rails, rules, and links remain square; curves belong to orbital diagrams, not interface chrome.

dos: Do use signal green as a scarce state and interaction color.
Do let large regular-weight Space Mono carry hierarchy through scale and spacing.
Do build structure with one-pixel rules, measured grids, axes, and disciplined alignment.
Do make motion slow, legible, and fully optional under reduced-motion preferences.
Do preserve generous viewport-scale pauses between major strategy frames.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, pills, soft dashboard containers, or conventional fund-site modules.
Don't substitute generic sans-serif display type or mix unrelated type families into the instrument voice.
Don't wash large surfaces in signal green or add competing accent colors.
Don't use generic drop shadows, glossy gradients, or decorative blur as the main depth language.
Don't hide essential identity, strategy copy, or contact actions behind motion.
